tasks.check: grep -qE 'MONITOR_COMPLETE|ESCALATE|MONITOR_BROKEN' monitor.txt || { echo 'FAIL: monitor ended without a terminal line:'; tail -4 monitor.txt; exit 1; }; if grep -q 'ESCALATE' monitor.txt; then echo "ESCALATION: $(grep -m1 'ESCALATE' monitor.txt)"; exit 1; fi; if grep -q 'MONITOR_BROKEN' monitor.txt; then echo 'monitor could not read the conversations API - degraded, needs a fix'; exit 1; fi; echo "PASS: $(grep -m1 'MONITOR_COMPLETE' monitor.txt)"
tasks.verified: Overnight watch on the live v113 line: every conversation polled through 08:30 ET, promise-silence and failure classes escalated rather than discovered by patients.
